lina: heads-up — ECC spike observed in us-west-2 / gpu-pool-7 starting ~10:12 UTC. 18 GPUs above 600 corrected errs/hr, p95 gen latency creeping up. digging in now.

amir: any immediate SLO impact or failed pods?

lina: p95 latency for /v1/generate up ~42% for that pool. saw a couple of OOMs. dmesg shows repeated `Xid=31` on several hosts. not yet pervasive across AZ.

infra-bot: ALERT: ECC_RATE_THRESHOLD breached for cluster us-west-2/gpu-pool-7 — 18 GPUs, avg=642 errs/hr. Incident ticket REDWOOD-3129 created.

katie: quick callout — last kernel roll bumped a driver on these nodes last week and we saw transient spikes. i suggest we avoid immediate full auto-drain. prefer 30m hysteresis + a host-level SNR and PCIe-retrain check before any mass evac.

jesse: running `gpu-health-scan --pool gpu-pool-7 --since 30m` now. sample output:
```
gpu 3: ecc_rate=710
gpu 5: ecc_rate=680
gpu 7: ecc_rate=1200
...
host node-uw7-12: riser_temp=78C, pcie_retrains=4/hr
```

sam: capacity heads-up — us-west-2 AZ-a has only 2 spare nodes in burst pool. if we drain >6 cards we risk saturating burst pool and pushing latency to other tenants.

maria: rough playbook proposal (short):
- verify persistent increase: rolling median over 30m > threshold
- correlate Xid types (31=mem, 43=fatal) and frequency
- run `nvml_query` + `check-firmware` on suspect hosts
- soft-evac nodes with `evac-rate-limit=2/min` if noisy and >8 cards affected
- if hardware confirmed failing, mark `drain=replace` and open RMA with vendor

amir: +1 to hysteresis and human gating for >10 GPUs. also add a circuit-breaker: if drains cause CPU/memory pressure >15% cluster-wide, abort further auto-drains and alert infra-paging.

katie: can we adopt adaptive thresholds? e.g. per-GPU baseline * 3 for 15m OR absolute floor 400/hr — avoids false positives on historically noisy cards.

jesse: deploying a dry-run of the updated autodrain policy with `--simulate` (will not evict) and logging decision reasons. posting results in ~10m.

lina: thanks. i'll coordinate with support to prepare vendor RMAs if the noise persists past 2 hours. keeping human review for now. (reaction :eyes:)

infra-bot: runbook link added: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gpu-ecc-triage

jesse: dry-run complete — simulation would have soft-evac'ed 3 nodes, flagged 9 GPUs for hardware review, no live evacs. attaching condensed log to REDWOOD-3129.
